stories.headline: Credit-union CEO ousted over viral 'Lake America' photo
stories.body: The CEO of a Michigan credit union was ousted after an AI-altered photo of her family wearing "Lake America" sweatshirts went viral, drawing criticism from Canadians.

stories.headline: U.S., China to lower tariffs on $60 billion of goods. Here's what qualifies
stories.body: The lists included U.S. imports of toys, sports equipment and Christmas decorations, while U.S. farm products appeared on the list of Chinese imports.
